title: Hud Scale
description: This mod allows you to change your Hud Scale.
body:
# HUD Scale 
With this tiny extension, you can change your Hud (Hearts, Hotbar, Hunger Bar) Scale.

This is possible without having to enlarge your GUI Scale.

Press "ß" to shrink, and "´" to enlargen your Hud.

Have fun :)
***
More Mods and features soon?
